name: Weekly trend, daily pullback
idea: While the Weekly trend is up (a rising trend average, or the swing structure), wait on the Daily chart for a pullback to the pullback average and a bullish reversal there (the mirror in a Weekly downtrend); the idea is wrong beyond the pullback's extreme.

params.label: Weekly trend by
params.help: What tells the Weekly trend: a rising (or falling) trend average with the close beyond it, or the swing structure (higher highs and higher lows, or the mirror).

params.label: Trend timeframe
params.help: The higher timeframe the trend is read on (closed bars only).

params.label: Average type
params.help: How the trend average and the pullback average are calculated.

params.label: Weekly trend average
params.help: For the trend average: the Weekly bars in it.

params.label: Trend slope over (weeks)
params.help: For the trend average: it must be higher (uptrend) or lower (downtrend) than it was this many Weekly bars before.

params.label: Weekly swing size
params.help: For the swing structure: which Weekly swings count (0 is the smaller, 1 the larger). Larger swings need much more history.

params.label: Daily pullback average
params.help: The Daily bars in the average the pullback comes back to.

params.label: Reversal within (bars)
params.help: The reversal must come within this many Daily bars after the pullback first reached the average.

params.label: The idea has ended
params.help: No exit signal from this template, or a close back across the pullback average.
choice_labels: A close back across the pullback average

constraints.message: The trend timeframe must be higher than the signal timeframe.
